name: Custom Pages
overview: Serve custom pages directly from your Jellyfin server with user permission restrictions for page access.
description: Custom Pages lets administrators publish pages served by Jellyfin at /pages/{slug}. Each page can be public or restricted to users or administrators, with access enforced by Jellyfin's own authorization policies.

versions.changelog:
## Initial Release

This creates the project. This is a fairly small plugin that uses the existing  items that already exist and are usable from a plugin layout to allow hosting custom pages. This enables you to host a page that you want users to have for reference while also keeping them permission gated behind .
